segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta

segments.text: The figures, however, Your Honor, only represent productivity and not the entirety of the performance.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Because under the SPJI, the Supreme Court has begun to pilot the high-performance courts framework.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Instead of just the number, it looks at internal processes, decision quality, court user satisfaction, and employee engagement.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Your Honors, also another important component of our effort to improve court performance, which will affect case disposition, is the continuing professionalization and decentralization of court administration through the Office of the Regional Court Managers, or ORCMs.

segments.text: Your Honor, the unfilled positions may either represent the organized courts or the unorganized courts.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: When it comes to organized, they're already existing.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So it is probable that we call it unfilled because some of the judge may have been promoted,

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: have already resigned, or has already retired or passed away.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Some of the personnel may have done the same.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But insofar as the courts who have no judges, we do assign other judges to be acting presiding judges on them

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: or to assist for that purpose.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: But that's actually the unfilled position.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: So we would need, likewise, even if they are characterized as unfilled, we would need a budget.

segments.text: For the judges, we have a temporary vacancy, meaning ito po yung nagaantay ng appointment sa presidente, 319.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Yung unorganized courts po, 170 or a total of 489.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Yung unorganized po, ito po yung newly created na nagaantay rin po kami ng NOSCA from the Department of Budget and Management.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ano nga ba yung courts natin?

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Ang total po ng courts namin is...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: We have a total of 2,885 courts po.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: That does not represent yung warm bodies po.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: I cannot do my math po, but that represents a percentage of...

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: Kasi po madali naman po talaga silang mapunan, ma-filled up.

segments.text: The JBS is very active on it.

segments.speaker: Court Administrator Theresa Dolores Gomez-Estoesta
segments.text: The Promotions Selection Board of the...

segments.text: First, Your Honor, I would like to give the picture that we have now in the city,

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: the law that we are talking about is Republic Act 12022,

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: and this was made effective last October 2025.

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: And so far, there are about 16 cases pending hearing before our courts.

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: And the first case filed is due for promulgation of the decision this October.

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: So I agree that there is yet no conviction because the cases were filed.

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena

segments.text: The first case filed was in March 2026.

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: So that case will have its promulgation of the decision this October.

segments.speaker: CTA Associate Justice Jean Marie A. Bacorro-Villena
segments.text: and there are presently incarcerated, Your Honor.

segments.text: Well, I just wanted this on record so that to inform also our justices and our judges.

segments.text: You know, agriculture smuggling is killing the local farming and fishing sector.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And our food security is compromised.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Not just food security, food safety.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Because what we are hearing is what are meant to be condemned in China are smuggled here,

segments.text: washed with formalin, and then brought into the wet markets.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ibebenta dito nang mataas na presyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So that's not just a health risk.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
